mentions.name: Ains
mentions.description: A static website for a side business supporting local artisans, built with Astro, React, and Shadcn. Its main interface is an OpenStreetMap Leaflet map paired with a custom calendar timeline, aimed at connecting with local artisans and helping them make a living from their handcrafted work.
mentions.problem: Local artisans need support to make a living from what they create with their hands
mentions.audience: Helping local artisans make a living from what they create with their hands
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've started a side business to support local artisans.

I want to help people making a living from what they've created with their hands. A major focus to do so is to connect with local artisans and learning from their perspective.

On the technical side, I'm developing a static site[0] with Astro / React / Shadcn. The main interface is a OSM leaflet map with a custom calendar timeline.
